# Fixtures

[Real DOM fragments](real) preserve M2 observed source research and unresolved policy. [Synthetic documents](documents) contain project-created Bangla/English text, tables, columns, raster scans, mixed pages and malformed PDF. Their manifest records SHA-256 and ownership; they are not real government notices or gold labels.

Unit tests make no source calls. Integration invokes local native tools and synthetic broker data. [Fixture generator](../../scripts/generate-document-fixtures.mjs), [benchmark](../../scripts/benchmark-documents.ts), [acceptance limits](../../docs/milestones/M3.md).
